**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

**Summary of investigation:**

- **Searched** for all standard MFN triggers — "most favoured", "most favored", "no less favorable/favourable", "best terms", "terms offered to" — all returned nothing. The only "best" hits are unrelated ("best effort basis", "best practices" security, "to the best of its knowledge").
- **Read the full document** (a single section, 75 paragraphs) to confirm no MFN-style obligation is buried outside the pricing provisions.
- **Checked the pricing provision directly** (§5 Fees and Payment, p0023): it is a revenue-share plus sequential-liability payment mechanic, with no requirement that AP match third-party offers or extend Kubient terms given to others.

**Direction analysis:** There is no MFN running in either direction. Critically, §1 (p0001) cuts the opposite way from an MFN burden — it confirms the arrangement is non-exclusive and expressly preserves AP's right to offer Inventory via other agents or sell to third parties without restriction. Nothing obliges AP to give Kubient its best terms.

This sits at the **preferred position** (no MFN obligation on Customer), so the rule is satisfied and no edit is appropriate. I noted in the rationale — but did not flag — that the agreement also gives AP no MFN in its favour; an MFN benefiting us would be welcome, but its absence is a commercial ask, not a playbook deviation.
